propositions: AGENTS.md and docs/user-guide.md contain stale prose claiming --force is CLI-only and not exposed over MCP for transition and claim operations, contradicting the shipped MCP surface and the 2026-08-18 ruling.
The force override is now available on all surfaces (library, CLI, MCP) per the operator ruling; auditability comes from the absence of a signed attestation rather than withholding the capability.
CI pipelines can enforce certification gates by checking for the absence of a force-written entry, preventing forced writes from bypassing gate checks.
The stale CLI-only clauses in both AGENTS.md and docs/user-guide.md must be rewritten to describe the force-everywhere + absent-attestation + CI-certification-enforcement model.
Out-of-scope CLI-only statements (--allow-secret-pattern override, interactive bridge setup, release-notes wizard) remain unchanged.
